title: RGCB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: The Rajiv Gandhi Center for Biotechnology (RGCB) has officially released a notification to fill 01 Junior Research Fellow vacancy. Interested and eligible candidates can use this opportunity to apply for this post before the last date of application. Candidates who have completed their MBBS, M.Sc., B.Pharm, B.E/ B.Tech can apply for the RGCB Notification 2026 . Interested applicants can apply online. Here we have mentioned the educational details, age limit, selection process, application fee...
